question:
Select the pair of letter clusters from among the given options that has the same relationship as the one given below:

BQZH ∶ OGXI ∶∶ ?
solution:
The alphabet template is given below:-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/286550159bb1b1af83b0ffca14b226c7cea8abbacc574e15aefc51c80aadcc47.png] 

The logic followed here is:-

In the first letter, we add 7 and shift to the fourth letter, then in the second letter, we add 7 and shifted to the third letter and so on.

From option 2:-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3eb4a038c383fd1131088e52ffd427eb2be03885c1a96d22e970ba2de8094a3.png] 

It is not followed.

From option 3:-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7054088405a7239cb27ce0ae70427e63e0004983c632c8fa4cf3dcbcb6908e38.png]
